title: Ready configuration for the F2 loop
statement: Let $body$ and $F$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean input string, and let $c$ be a configuration of $F$ on input $x$. The ready configuration is obtained by capturing the fuel of $c$ and applying the loop-frame construction with initial host state in the $body$ branch, body state $body.tm.q₀$, Boolean flag true, fuel parameter $1$, the specified buffer tapes for the empty string, the output of $c$, and the empty string, head-position parameters $0,0$, and empty output; it has $body.k+1+(1+F.k)+1$ work tapes and state set $F.State\oplus((Bool\times(body.State\times Bool))\oplus Fin(14))$.
hypotheses_covered: $body$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
$F$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
$c$ is a configuration of $F$ on input $x$
